items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: Yeah, I played them a couple of times around there, you know. They didn't think I could play, you know.

ctx.x: Well they had the original Dixieland? That's right.

Nick Lerocka. I went a couple of times with them. Then they went to New York, that's when they made the Liberty Stable Blues. You worked with that band? Yeah, I played them a couple of times around there, you know. They didn't think I could play, you know. And that's when they made up their band. They went to New York and made the Liberty Stable Blues and then things busted loose. And that was really telling the truth about it. They wasn't causing Dixieland really getting on top of it like they did. Yeah, they…
They sure did, they sure did. Yeah, they did. They made these records.
